root_cause: Landing-page persuasion models existed partially across SEO and outreach, but page composition, behavioral decisioning, downstream revenue weighting and Powerhouse Brain projection were not one machine-enforced canonical capability.
decision: Extend CAPABILITY_SEO_CONVERSION_ORDERS and existing Growth Swarm/Persuasion authority instead of creating a parallel CRO stack.
prevention: All commercial landing-page persuasion must inherit the canonical behavioral revenue skill.
Page changes must optimize terminal commercial outcomes over raw clicks.
No dark patterns or unsupported proof.
Maximum three reversible evidence-gated changes per daily cycle.
Capability must remain projected in the Brain component registry and inherited by Growth Swarm and Persuasion skills.
promotion_rule: Promote from TESTING only after protected merge, production readback and downstream outcome evidence.
